periods.name: 卡邦克鲁微粒化/土中游动
periods.description: Carbuncle can turn herself and nearby earth into particles finer than sand, allowing bullets and blades to pass through and enabling movement through the ground. It consumes heavy magic, so Kinji's team forces her to fight while depleted.
